representation_fit.evidence: Brief asks understand × temporal-sequence on change_set with causality readable; impl is a change-event timeline (18 events, 11 causal edges) with SVG causal edges drawn only in time-forward direction (source/app.js:222-270 drawEdges), day-grouped chronological rows (source/app.js:150-169), and a time cursor with fold semantics stateAt(k)=initialState+events[0..k] (source/app.js:85-94). High-temporality facet served by timeline+cursor; medium relational facet served by per-row cause/lead chips (source/app.js:196-197). Primary object suggestion change_set matched.

primary_task_salience.evidence: Initial screen in both screenshots/1280x860.png and screenshots/1440x900.png is dominated by 变更时间轴 (widest column minmax(460px,1.3fr), source/styles.css:169) with causal edges visible; default selection pre-opens the causal pivot incident e06 (source/app.js:19 '默认选中因果枢纽事件'), so causal reading is demonstrated on first paint without any interaction.

time_to_understand.evidence: Header states system+observation window and a data-integrity line '自检 ✓ 18 事件 · 11 条因果边全部时间正向 · 22 处字段前值与折叠一致' (visible top-right of both screenshots; source/app.js:627); three panels are explicitly labeled 变更时间轴/事件检查器/状态快照; toolbar carries keyboard hints (source/index.html:31). What/where is conveyed at a glance; no loading state (source/index.html:80, synchronous render).

navigation_cost.evidence: Single page, zero navigation to reach primary object: timeline, inspector, snapshot co-visible (source/index.html:34-78). Causal jumps are one click via chips (source/app.js:137-143) or one keypress ↑/↓, C, Home/End, Esc (source/app.js:599-621); deep links #e/#c=/#f= supported (source/app.js:643-650).

context_loss.evidence: All primary actions are in-place: select() only re-renders inspector/highlight without leaving the timeline view (source/app.js:302-312); cursor is independent of selection with an explicit align action; chips targeting filtered-out events first reset filters so the target stays reachable instead of dead-ending (source/app.js:139, 373, 391). No mode switches or route changes exist.

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent controls map 1:1 to the brief's facets: 6 type chips double as legend+filter (source/index.html:25, source/app.js:541-558), one component select, reset, cursor slider + 3 cursor buttons (source/index.html:53-58). No redundant chrome, settings, or placeholder nav despite many-cardinality data; density stays medium as the shape bundle requires.

accessibility.evidence: Receipt checks a11y.contrast=pass, a11y.focus_order=pass, a11y.target_size=pass (measurement-summary.json); source shows deliberate engineering: roving tabindex listbox pattern (source/app.js:175, 289-298), aria-pressed/aria-label throughout, :focus-visible outline (source/styles.css:504-509), pre-mixed opaque washes for controlled contrast (source/styles.css:33-34), color always paired with glyph+label (source/data.js:44-58). Held to 4 by receipt fail type.min_projected_size: chips/badges at 10.5px, panel heads 11px, hints 11.5px (source/styles.css:350, 314, 196-199, 159) are small text surfaces.

frontend_rework.evidence: layout.overflow=pass, layout.responsive_collision=pass, text.truncation=pass (measurement-summary.json); both screenshots render cleanly at 1280x860 and 1440x900 with no visible defect (1440x900 additionally shows row 10:30 without collision). One receipt failure (type.min_projected_size) plus 1 unattributed warning imply a typography rework pass would be needed; no layout rework indicated.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '时间结构与变更语义一致' is explicit and enforced three ways: declared invariants (source/data.js:1-8), boot-time validation of strictly increasing ts, cause-ts < effect-ts, and from-values matching the fold (source/app.js:55-82), and a visible header integrity readout '全部时间正向 · 22 处字段前值与折叠一致' in both screenshots (source/app.js:624-635) with an error banner path if validation fails (source/app.js:630-634).

defects_observed: Receipt check type.min_projected_size fails: multiple permanent text surfaces render at 10.5–11.5px (chips source/styles.css:350, badges source/styles.css:314, panel heads source/styles.css:196-199, kbd hint source/styles.css:159) below comfortable minimum projected size.
Measurement summary reports 1 warning not attributed to any check id, so its nature cannot be assessed.

Inspector buttons are removed from the Tab order (tabIndex=-1, source/app.js:411) and reachable only via arrow keys from the panel container (source/app.js:585-597) — a deliberate roving pattern and focus_order passed, but it is a non-standard interaction worth noting.
missing_evidence: The sanitized summary's single warning is not mapped to a check id, so which check carries it is unobservable.
Focus-ring appearance and cursor/snapshot interaction states are not captured in the two initial-page screenshots; assessment of those relies on source structure plus the passing receipt checks.
scores.overall_note: impl-09 is a single-page change timeline that matches the brief's understand × temporal-sequence shape closely: a dominant vertical event timeline with time-forward causal edges, an inspector showing field-level 前值→后值 diffs with cause/lead jumps, and a time cursor that folds events into a per-component state snapshot (source/app.js:85-94, 222-270). The acceptance seed is not just depicted but machine-validated at boot and surfaced as a header integrity readout (source/app.js:55-82, 624-635), and both screenshots show a clean, fully rendered initial state with the causal pivot event pre-selected. Receipt checks pass on layout, truncation, and all three a11y dimensions; the single failure is type.min_projected_size, consistent with the many 10.5–11.5px text surfaces in the source, which is the main thing keeping accessibility and rework scores below the top. Task completion time, retrieval accuracy, and human preference are not observable in this blind pilot, and model-judged legibility here is a proxy, not human preference.
